nurse.text: Alright, my lover? Welcome to Bristol Sanctuary. Pop them on the counter, I'll sort them right out.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's tea in the pot and a slice of lardy cake if the seagulls haven't had it. Make yourself at home.
There you go, gert lush! Fit as a fiddle, the lot of them. Cheers, drive. Sorry, habit.
The Ark's in the corner, my love. Someone's stuck a little stencil of a gull on it. Nobody owns up.

else.text: No bother at all. Mind how you go on the cobbles, they're lethal in the drizzle.
